messages:
anya (eng-security): FYI: DSAR deletion tasks started failing after morning key rotation. deletion-service logs show PERMISSION_DENIED and DECRYPTION_FAILED. @sam can you check the rotation?
sam (eng-platform): rotation ran at 04:12 UTC. rotation script updated active key version but the IAM sync step hit a transient API error and didn't retry. looks like dsar-processor@redwood-prod lost decrypt role on new version.
jules (eng-sre): about 17 jobs blocked in waiting-for-decrypt state. stacktrace: kms.cryptoKeyVersions.accessDenied.
marta (privacy): pulling the DSAR queue now. any SLA risks?
audit-bot: log: user:sam@redwood action:kms.keys.update time:2026-03-21T04:12:08Z resource:projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/retention/cryptoKeys/dsr-key
sam (eng-platform): applying temporary binding for dsar-processor: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. will post audit event when done.
anya (eng-security): after binding, run a smoke decrypt + deletion dry-run and report result here.
sam (eng-platform): binding applied. smoke output: OK: kms.decrypt succeeded; deletion dry-run OK.
jules (eng-sre): retried 17 jobs -> 15 succeeded, 2 failed with ENCRYPTED_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH (old-version ciphertext). manual cleanup planned.
marta (privacy): none breached SLA. legal wants incident note and proof of mitigation. question: do rotated keys affect our ability to prove deletion?
anya (eng-security): root cause: rotation runbook lacked retry+post-rotation verification. fixes: add 3x retry on IAM sync, add post-rotate smoke-check script that runs kms.decrypt + delete dry-run, and alerting for repeated PERMISSION_DENIED from deletion-service.
sam (eng-platform): opening INFRA-2691 to patch pipeline and add tools/keystore-smoke.sh.
jules (eng-sre): manual cleanup done for the 2 mismatches, marking done.
marta (privacy): tracker updated, legal notified.
anya (eng-security): filing postmortem and tasks: INFRA-2691, SEC-4202, PRIV-101. closing thread once postmortem link posted.
